formulas.name: ClosedPushUpNotificationBody_Formula
formulas.expression: IF(TEXT({!Loop_Connect_Users.LanguageLocaleKey})='fr',"La déclaration de CA suivante a été validée: "&{!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.Name}&". Cliquez ici pour en consulter les détails.","The following Sell-In Revenue Statement has been validated "&{!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.Name}&". Click here to view the details.")

formulas.name: ClosedPushUpNotificationSubject_Formula
formulas.expression: IF(TEXT({!Loop_Connect_Users.LanguageLocaleKey})='fr',"Nouvelle validation de votre déclaration de CA","New Sell-In Statement Validation")

formulas.name: LongNameFormula
formulas.expression: {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.NegoScope__r.Name} + " - " + TEXT({!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.ReferenceYear__c}) + " - " + IF( TEXT({!Loop_Connect_Users.LanguageLocaleKey}) = "fr", CASE( TEXT({!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.PeriodType__c}), "Month", "Mensuelle", "Trimester", "Trimestrielle", "Semester", "Semestrielle", "Annual", "Annuelle", "" ), TEXT({!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.PeriodType__c}) ) + ' - ' + CASE( TEXT({!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.PeriodType__c}), "Month", {!Period_Type_Label.value}, "Trimester", {!Period_Type_Label.value} + " " + TEXT( {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.PeriodNumber__c} ), "Semester", {!Period_Type_Label.value} + " " + TEXT( {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.PeriodNumber__c} ), "Annual", TEXT( {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.PeriodNumber__c} ), "" ) + " - (" + TEXT( {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.Version__c} ) + ")"

formulas.name: RequestedPushUpNotificationBody_Formula
formulas.expression: IF(TEXT({!Loop_Connect_Users.LanguageLocaleKey})='fr',"Une demande de révision vous a été envoyée pour la déclaration de CA "&{!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.Name}&". formulas.name: SellInDetailsHeaders
formulas.expression:
CASE(SUBSTITUTE({!Get_SellIn_Headers}, "\"", ""), "LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableRevenue", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableRevenue}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableRevenue}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableRevenue}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableRevenue} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>", "LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableRevenue", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableRevenue}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableRevenue}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableRevenue}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableRevenue} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>", "LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableRevenue", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableRevenue}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableRevenue}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableRevenue}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableRevenue} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>", "LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableRevenue", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableRevenue}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableRevenue}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableRevenue}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableRevenue} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>", "LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableQuantity", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableQuantity}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableQuantity}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableQuantity}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_RegularDiscountableQuantity} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>",
"LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableQuantity", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableQuantity}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableQuantity}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableQuantity}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_PromoDiscountableQuantity} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>",
"LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableQuantity", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableQuantity}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableQuantity}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableQuantity}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_TotalDiscountableQuantity} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>", "LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableQuantity", "<th style=\"text-align:right;\">" & IF( RIGHT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableQuantity}, 1) = ":", LEFT({!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableQuantity}, LEN({!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableQuantity}) - 1), {!$Label.LBL_Connect_NonDiscountableQuantity} ) & " - " & {!$Label.LBL_Period} & "</th>", "" )

textTemplates.name: RequestedEmailNotificationBodyEN
textTemplates.text:
Hello {!Loop_Connect_Users.FirstName} {!Loop_Connect_Users.LastName},


ℹ️ {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.NegoScope__r.Owner:User.FirstName} {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.NegoScope__r.Owner:User.LastName} is requesting a review for certain details from your sell-in revenue statement {!LongNameFormula}. In order to make sure that your information is accurate, please be sure to review and update the requested information if necessary.


📶 Verification details:


{!SSDTable}


➡️ Next steps:

  1. Please log in on the Connect platform: click here
  2. Double check your statement
  3. Update the requested lines if necessary and submit your changes


Thank you for your collaboration,

The Connect team

textTemplates.name: RequestedEmailNotificationBodyFR
textTemplates.text:
Bonjour {!Loop_Connect_Users.FirstName} {!Loop_Connect_Users.LastName},


ℹ️ Des lignes de déclaration de CA ont été identifiées par votre interlocuteur {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.NegoScope__r.Owner:User.FirstName} {!Get_Current_SellIn_Statement.NegoScope__r.Owner:User.LastName} comme nécessitant une action de votre part. Elles concernent la déclaration {!LongNameFormula}. Afin d’assurer l’exactitude des informations, nous vous invitons à consulter votre déclaration et à vérifier les informations nécessaires.


📶 Détail de la révision à effectuer:


{!SSDTable}


➡️ Que faire ?

  1. Connectez-vous à la plateforme Connect : cliquer ici
  2. Accédez à votre déclaration en cours
  3. Modifiez les lignes signalées si nécessaire et envoyez votre mise à jour


Merci pour votre collaboration.

L'équipe Connect
